title: [AUG-216] Keep August updates in the running install folder and make the Windows data folder independent of it
why_we_need_this: AUG-207 found why a silent update "wiped" a user's data on Windows: the NSIS installer takes its target folder only from the registry (HKCU `Software\{appGuid}` InstallLocation). The old uninstaller deletes that key during every update and the installer writes it back at the end, so an update cut in between (BSOD, power loss, kill) leaves a working install with no registry trace. The next silent update then installs into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\August`, and because the Windows data dir is `<install dir>\data` (@electron/src/main.ts configureServerEnv), the app starts with empty sessions, preferences and API keys while the real data sits in the old folder. Any user with a custom install folder can hit this; an interactive reinstall into another folder strands data the same way. Two changes close it: (A) the updater tells the installer to use the folder of the running app, (B) the app remembers its data folder in `%APPDATA%\August` so data no longer follows the install folder. Full analysis: @project-context/desktop-shell/README.md, section "Install folder drift and data left behind (AUG-207)".
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] A. On packaged Windows builds @electron/src/updater.ts sets `autoUpdater.installDirectory` to the folder of `process.execPath`, so the installer is started with `/D=<that folder>`; the `[updater] Executing:` line in main.log shows the `/D=` argument as the last argument.
- [ ] A. On macOS and in unpackaged runs nothing changes: the assignment is guarded by `process.platform === 'win32'` and `app.isPackaged`.
- [ ] B. A pure module (no Electron imports) resolves the Windows data dir from three inputs (install-dir data path, pointer content, folder-exists check) with these rules: no pointer → `<install dir>\data`; pointer to an existing folder → that folder, even when it differs from `<install dir>\data`; pointer to a missing folder → `<install dir>\data`.
- [ ] B. configureServerEnv in @electron/src/main.ts (win32 branch only) uses that module and writes the pointer `%APPDATA%\August\data-location.json` (UTF-8 JSON, field with the absolute data dir) after every start whenever the resolved folder changed or the pointer was missing or stale.
- [ ] B. When the pointer wins over `<install dir>\data`, or points to a missing folder, one line is written to main.log naming both paths; nothing about it is shown in the user UI.
- [ ] B. Two data folders are never merged, moved or deleted automatically.
- [ ] B. An explicit `AUGUST_DATA_DIR` environment variable still wins over both the pointer and the install-dir default (current `??=` behaviour).
- [ ] B. The macOS data dir stays `~/Library/Application Support/August/data`; no pointer file is read or written on darwin.
- [ ] B. @electron/build/installer.nsh customUnInstall deletes `%APPDATA%\August\data-location.json` on a manual uninstall and keeps it on updates (`--updated`), in the same block and shell context as model-dir / gpu-engine.
- [ ] Unit tests cover every resolve rule above plus a non-ASCII (Cyrillic) path round-trip through the pointer file, and run for both `win32` and `darwin` platform values; `npm run electron:test` and the server tests pass.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes and the Electron smoke test (AUGUST_SMOKE_TEST=1) prints SMOKE_OK.
- [ ] The desktop-shell route is updated: the AUG-207 section and TL;DR say what is implemented, and the "`<install dir>/data`" statements in the desktop-shell and architecture routes mention the pointer.
important_constraints:
- User decision 2026-11-16: implement options A + B from AUG-207; no VM or second Windows profile verification is required — unit tests, build and smoke test are the bar. State in the result that the installer path was not exercised end to end.
- Never run installers or uninstallers against the real install (`D:\claude\August\installed`) and never touch its `data` or the registry key `HKCU\Software\8ed30dcd-7880-51a9-bc47-ea538a6afaa3`.
- Cross-platform rules from the project CLAUDE.md apply: @electron/src/main.ts is a highest-risk shared file; every new branch is guarded by `process.platform`; paths go through `path.join()`.
- `/D=` must stay the last installer argument: keep `autoUpdater.disableWebInstaller = true` (electron-updater appends `--package-file` after `/D=` only for web installers).
- The pointer is written by the app, not by NSIS: NSIS FileWrite uses the ANSI codepage and breaks non-ASCII paths (see the model-dir handling in main.ts).
- Do not change where data lives for existing users: no migration to a fixed `%APPDATA%\August\data`, no data move.
- Do not change the AUG-158 logic (augBackupUserData, augRestoreUserData, customRemoveFiles); the only installer.nsh change is the pointer cleanup in customUnInstall. The manual-uninstall "remove data" prompt keeps targeting `$INSTDIR\data`.
- Out of scope: installer hardening (rewriting InstallLocation after the old uninstaller, folder-change warning) and the MSI target.
- Known limit to document, not fix: with a pointer to a temporarily missing drive the app falls back to `<install dir>\data` and rewrites the pointer.
- Related: AUG-207 (research), AUG-158 (update data preservation). Commits go straight to master.
